Use case: ui-mockup. Existing native macOS desktop app Potato. Target dimensions 1080 x 760 pixels matching attached screenshot. Current date 2026-09-06; avoid visible dates. Preserve sidebar width 236px and the chat layout and compact ~96px composer; no new brand style, colored accents, dashboard cards, metrics or decorative graphics. Remove the purple screen-sharing indicator from reference; simple macOS titlebar.
Design ONE coherent concept in ONE full application window. Not a collage of unrelated options, not a presentation slide; no annotations or descriptive essay outside app. Focus on archive navigation in sidebar. Top sidebar rows are 新建, 搜索, 定时, 技能, 记忆; bottom Potato settings and theme icon. Input placeholder 描述任务…; bottom controls plus, folder 默认, 本机 · 自动, 选择模型, microphone and send icon. Keep these surrounding UI elements visually subordinate and unchanged.
Archive is a low-frequency destination. Do not show a permanent standalone button labeled 归档 beside 会话. Distinguish navigating to 已归档 from the per-conversation action 归档会话. No failure badges or counts. Conversation rows as flat text rows, no cards or repeated timestamps. Overflow menu icons show only on one hovered row at most. Archived conversations must be recoverable; no destructive delete buttons on main surface. Mock titles 聊天界面优化, Rust 原生前端检查, 工具调用显示, 项目结构梳理. App should feel calm, quiet, readable and grounded in attached screenshot. Whitespace first; faint dividers when needed; popover shadows very restrained. Use exact, readable Chinese.

The old far-right archive button is completely removed. Show its compact anchored dropdown OPEN directly underneath the title, sized about196px wide and84px tall: only two rows 会话 and 已归档. 会话 has one small check on the right, 已归档 uses a tiny archive outline icon on the left. Quiet white popover with delicate border, 8px radius and minimal shadow. Behind/below the popover remain a few regular conversation titles. The selected conversation is 聊天界面优化 with a soft gray row background. Clicking 已归档 would switch the same list, changing the header to 已归档 plus chevron. The image itself shows the open menu in the regular conversation state. Put the visible header 会话 only once above the menu; no extra headings, no explanatory microcopy, no permanent 返回 button. Keep main chat fully undimmed; menu does not take over the workspace.

Concept name: 就近查找. Explore a nearby archive lookup interaction without replacing the normal sidebar list. Sidebar section label is plain 会话 with a small subtle ellipsis at its far right, visible only because this header is hovered. NO standalone archive button. Normal conversation rows remain fully visible below it, one selected. The header overflow entry 查看已归档 has just opened a quiet narrow archive flyout anchored NEXT TO the sidebar at x244 y256, width300px height280px, floating over only the left edge of the main conversation. This single archive flyout is the hero interaction; do not also draw another menu. Flyout title 已归档 at left and subtle close icon at right; three flat archived conversation rows: 早期界面草稿, 模型连接测试, 旧版迁移记录. No counters, timestamps or descriptions. First row hovered with a small restore outline icon only on hover at its right; a tiny tooltip 恢复会话 can identify that icon. Clicking a row would inspect its conversation; restoring puts it back in the normal list. Show one short footer action 查看全部 with right chevron. Lightweight anchored white surface with a delicate border and soft shadow. Main chat stays completely undimmed and normal sidebar list remains normal. No centered modal, no permanent archive nav row, no arrows or instructional labels outside UI. This design intentionally keeps archive lookup transient so the user cannot accidentally leave the entire sidebar in an archived mode.

Concept name: 独立管理. Explore a focused archive manager opened from a quiet overflow menu next to the sidebar 会话 heading. The normal sidebar keeps its normal conversation list and selected chat. NO permanent archive nav button, NO replacing sidebar with archived-only results. Show one compact centered archive-management dialog over the current chat, centered primarily within the white main content pane; about480px wide and340px high. Surrounding app is visible with a very light neutral translucent scrim, not dark dramatic dimming. Dialog is white, 12px corner radius, subtle border and shadow. Top title 已归档 with small close X at top right. One compact search input below, placeholder 搜索已归档会话 with magnifying icon. Below, three plain aligned list rows with titles 早期界面草稿, 模型连接测试, 旧版迁移记录; each has a clear small text-only 恢复 button at right, no colored primary actions. Light thin separators only, no nested cards, no checkboxes, no batch actions, no delete, no counts or timestamps. Spacious but compact; no instructional paragraphs or empty filler areas. The archive dialog is the only focal overlay. No second menu open. Restoring a row removes it from this dialog and puts it in normal conversations; closing returns directly to the existing chat. This direction prioritizes unambiguous dedicated recovery over quick toggling. Reuse original app typography and neutral palette strictly; exact Chinese labels.
